title: Signal front-end: rational resampling, autocorrelation F0 and energy-based syllable segmentation
hypothesis: A windowed-sinc rational resampler (44.1 kHz -> 24 kHz, L/M=80/147) preserves the 0.5-4 kHz passband within 0.5 dB and attenuates a 15 kHz tone by >=40 dB; normalized-autocorrelation F0 tracking recovers 100-400 Hz contours within 3% on synthetic signals; energy-valley segmentation recovers 4 synthetic syllables without merging; every analysis failure is reported as a counted issue instead of being filtered out.

git.status: dirty (src/vhe/data/{f0,resample,segment}.py, tests/test_data_frontend.py uncommitted during the run)

notes: No RNG is used: every signal is analytic, so repeated runs are byte-identical. Synthetic signals only; the AISHELL-3 corpus is not on this machine, so no real-speech or listening evidence exists.
